Select exact IC50 measurements for compounds tested against human BTK (CHEMBL5251). Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records, docs, activities, assays, and target_dictionary. Filter by target CHEMBL5251 and standard_type IC50. Require exact values (standard_relation = '='). Require compound_structures (canonical_smiles present) and docs (pubmed_id or doi present). Return compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism. Keep all activity rows; do not deduplicate. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism.
